verdict.rationale: A tax authority's filing and payment services could plausibly offer versioned programmatic APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only two probes showing 403 edge denials on the main site and the MyFTB/Web Pay host. Neither documents any API, versioning scheme or deprecation policy, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
